test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 205 712 237 862 578 (Right)

(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7) (NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.) What will be the resultant if the third digit of the highest number is added to the first digit of the lowest number?
solution:
The given three-digit numbers are: 205, 712, 237, 862, 578.

The highest number is 862. Its third digit is 2.

The lowest number is 205. Its first digit is 2.

Add the third digit of the highest number 2 to the first digit of the lowest number 2.

2 + 2 = 4.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
